# Web TTYd Hub

> Independent self-hosted ttyd + tmux browser terminal session manager, extended from sosopop/web-ttyd-hub.

Repository: https://github.com/learner20230724/web-ttyd-hub
Languages: Chinese and English.
Use cases: remote CLI, named terminal sessions, mobile access, long-running command-line tasks, shared terminals, clipboard troubleshooting.
Inherited: Vue session UI, create/stop/restart/delete, shell selection, tmux persistence, HTTP/WebSocket proxy.
Fork additions: native xterm.js desktop scrolling over tmux control mode, independent per-browser scroll position, retained history and ANSI color restoration on reconnect, no separate History overlay, IME and bracketed paste; Android WebView online UI with saved server switching and separate encrypted logins; mobile answer/full-output reader, terminal keys and content caching; unread completion indicators, Unicode names, persistent session IDs and labels, ordering, pins, 30-minute recoverable archive and process-preserving deployments.
Limits: full-screen application state and PTY geometry remain shared; discarded terminal output is unrecoverable; no cross-device clipboard synchronization, no process resurrection after machine reboot, no built-in tenant isolation. M153 hardware testing has not been completed.
Public deployment: authenticated HTTPS proxy, dedicated service OS user.
Requirements: Node.js 22.12+, npm, ttyd with -W support, tmux 3.4+, Linux/macOS.
License: MIT as declared in upstream README; attribution in NOTICE.
